_about: Every public-domain C. H. Spurgeon (1834-1892) text the Word Hoard holds. CCEL ThML (clean) for the sermons, 63 volumes (1855-1917, the New Park Street and Metropolitan Tabernacle Pulpit as CCEL issues them), and seven other CCEL works. The Treasury of David is NOT taken from CCEL: CCEL's treasury1-6 XML files are stubs (about 4 KB of text each; the psalms live on separate web pages), so it is held as Internet Archive OCR of the seven-volume American printing (Funk & Wagnalls, 1882-1886), assembled from two scan series, each volume identified by the psalm range on its title page. Raw and unconverted. Gutenberg Spurgeon titles were not searched this burn.
